decisions.title: 100% Offline @fontsource & qrcode.react Override CDN Snippets

decisions.title: UoB Drop #1 Single Active Hub, GBP (£) Integer-Pence Math & Card Pre-Authorisation Hold
decisions.summary: Launch with 1 active hub (Vale · Shackleton; 3 other UoB hubs as coming_soon votes), £0.00 crate fee >= £9.00 (£0.39 micro-crate fee < £9.00), integer GBP pence math, and Card Pre-Authorisation Hold copy.

decisions.author: system
decisions.title: PalletCut Brand Rename + Tactile Citrus-Crate Palette Kept for Launch
decisions.summary: Rebrand product identity to PalletCut (palletcut-icon.svg / palletcut-logo.svg) while keeping the tactile #F7FAF8 chalk canvas, 1.5px–2px solid #0B241C borders, 3px 3px 0px #0B241C hard shadows, and radial SVG <SliceMeter />.
decisions.rationale: Founder resolution: rename to PalletCut now and preserve current tactile UI tokens for launch.

decisions.title: Radial SVG <SliceMeter /> Only (No Horizontal Progress Bars)
decisions.summary: Display open-box slice progress exclusively via segmented radial SVG wedges (#10D48E stranger slices, #FF6B1A popped user slice, #EDF7F2 open wedges).
decisions.rationale: page-syles.md & AGENTS.md signature SplitBox visual craft requirement.
